prompt: In this watercolor illustration, the cluttered backstage area of a grand theatre reveals a moment of chaotic preparation. On the left, a tall man in a velvet coat stands rigidly while holding a script tightly against his chest. Next to him, a young woman with braided hair sits on a wooden crate, her posture slumped in exhaustion. A small brown dog rests beside her feet, looking up expectantly at the seated woman. In the center, an older actor with white hair points dramatically toward a hanging spotlight above. A stagehand in blue overalls looks at the pointing actor, listening intently to the direction. Hanging from the ceiling near them is a heavy sandbag, swaying slightly in the draft. To the right, a dancer in a pink tutu adjusts her ribbons while standing next to a large potted fern. A black cat perches on top of the fern's leaves, watching the dancer with narrowed eyes. Behind the dancer, a makeup artist with glasses applies powder to the face of a nervous understudy. The understudy holds a mirror with trembling hands, checking the reflection closely. Leaning against the wall nearby is a broken violin, its strings snapped and dangling loosely. A stack of playbills lies scattered on the floor near the broken instrument. A prop sword rests on a table next to the playbills, gleaming faintly under the dim lights. There is no audience visible in the background shadows. There is no curtain drawn across the stage opening.
